preconditions.description: Input contains exactly four space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == "-1" or all(int(x) == 1 for x in stdin.split())
postconditions.description: If output is '-1', the safe is secure (impossible to crack). Otherwise, the sequence of operations transforms all four numbers to 1.
The number of operations does not exceed 1000 if a solution exists.

postconditions.expression: all(op in ['/1', '/2', '/3', '/4', '+1', '+2', '+3', '+4'] for op in stdout.splitlines()) if stdout.strip() != "-1" else True
postconditions.description: Each operation is valid (either '/' or '+' followed by a position 1-4).
